definition: a coming home again after time away
description: Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.

en.question: What is the girl pulling behind her?

de.answer: Es zieht einen mit Aufklebern übersäten Koffer hinter sich her.
phrases: sich auf ihr Bett fallen lassen
de.question: Was zieht das Mädchen hinter sich her?

es.answer: Está arrastrando una maleta cubierta de pegatinas.
es.question: ¿Qué está arrastrando la chica detrás de sí?

fr.answer: Elle tire une valise couverte d'autocollants.
phrases: se laisser tomber sur son lit
fr.question: Que tire la fille derrière elle ?
